grid=[[0]*21 for _ in range(21)]
pts={3:[(0,14),(3,17),(5,9),(6,10),(6,13),(8,15),(8,17)],4:[(3,2)],6:[(2,3),(17,3)],7:[(2,6)],1:[(2,7),(17,7)],8:[(13,10),(15,16),(17,13)]}
# preserve source seeds
for col,ps in pts.items():
 for r,c in ps:grid[r][c]=col
# vertical connect aligned 1 and 6
for color,c,r0,r1 in [(1,7,2,17),(6,3,2,17)]:
 for r in range(r0,r1+1):grid[r][c]=color
# raster lines
def line(a,b,color):
 r0,c0=a;r1,c1=b
 dr=abs(r1-r0);dc=abs(c1-c0);sr=1 if r0<r1 else -1;sc=1 if c0<c1 else -1
 err=dc-dr
 while True:
  grid[r0][c0]=color
  if (r0,c0)==(r1,c1):break
  e2=2*err
  if e2>-dr:err-=dr;c0+=sc
  if e2<dc:err+=dc;r0+=sr
# perimeter order
p3=[(0,14),(3,17),(8,17),(8,15),(6,13),(6,10),(5,9)]
for a,b in zip(p3,p3[1:]+p3[:1]):line(a,b,3)
# 8 path
for a,b in zip(pts[8],pts[8][1:]):line(a,b,8)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in grid))
